title: Refined outer-approximation algorithms for monotonic optimisation
summary: Monotonic optimisation is a broad class of non-convex problems formulated in terms of monotone functions. Such problems are commonly solved via the polyblock outer-approximation algorithm (POA), a branch-and-bound method that iteratively refines a rectangular outer-approximation of the feasible set. POA scales poorly, however: the number of vertices needed to describe the approximation can grow exponentially, leading to large memory requirements and increasingly expensive subroutines. To address these limitations, we propose three algorithmic improvements: a generalised anchor selection that yields an optimal balanced monotonicity cut, a relaxed optimality condition that guarantees finite termination without continuity assumptions, and a vectorised variant that processes multiple nodes concurrently. We further develop an efficient tree-based implementation, which accelerates POA's core subroutines while storing the outer-approximation compactly. Numerical experiments show that these improvements yield order-of-magnitude speed-ups over standard POA and solve problems on which existing variants fail. Finally, we introduce polyblocks, an open-source Python package implementing the proposed algorithms alongside a framework for developing new POA variants, available at https://github.com/RashwanA/polyblocks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对单调优化中的polyblock外逼近算法（POA）扩展性差的问题，提出了三项算法改进：广义锚点选择（最优平衡单调性切割）、松弛最优性条件（无需连续性假设的有限终止保证）和向量化并行变体，并设计了高效的树形数据结构实现，显著加速POA核心子程序。数值实验表明改进方法比标准POA提速一个数量级，能解决现有变体失败的难题。作者还开源了Python包polyblocks提供一个开发新POA变体的框架。
AI.motivation: 单调优化是一类广泛的非凸问题，常用POA算法求解。但POA存在严重的扩展性问题：描述外部逼近所需的顶点数可能呈指数增长，导致内存占用大、子程序越来越昂贵，限制了其在实际问题中的应用。
AI.method: 提出三项核心改进：1) 广义锚点选择，生成最优平衡单调性切割；2) 松弛最优性条件，在不需连续性假设下保证有限终止；3) 向量化变体，并发处理多个节点。此外开发了基于树形结构的高效实现，加速POA核心子程序并紧凑存储外部逼近。
AI.result: 数值实验表明所提出的改进相比标准POA实现了数量级的加速，并能成功求解现有变体无法处理的问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法改进和高效数据结构实现，显著提升了POA的效率和可扩展性，同时发布了开源的polyblocks包以促进该领域算法开发与复现。

title: Multi-period Value-at-Risk Constrained Portfolio Optimization via DC Programming
summary: We study a multi-period portfolio optimization problem with finite-scenario Value-at-Risk (VaR) constraints, transaction costs, and diversification regularization. Using a finite-scenario VaR--CVaR identity, we derive a penalized difference-of-convex (DC) formulation over the underlying convex portfolio set. To solve the resulting nonsmooth and nonconvex problem, we propose a projected inertial Boosted Difference-of-Convex Functions Algorithm (iBDCA) that combines inertial extrapolation, an objective safeguard, and a boosted line search. We prove that the method is well defined, generates a monotonically decreasing objective sequence, and has only critical accumulation points for the penalized DC problem. Under a local no-ties condition at an accumulation point, we further establish whole sequence convergence with a local \(R\)-linear rate. Numerical experiments compare iBDCA with DCA and standard BDCA on matched problem instances. Out-of-sample backtests additionally include equal-weight and buy-and-hold benchmarks to illustrate the trade-offs among realized return, risk, transaction costs, and empirical VaR control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种投影惯性增强差分凸函数算法（iBDCA），用于求解带有限场景VaR约束、交易成本和分散化正则化的多期组合优化问题，并从理论和数值两方面验证了算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 多期组合优化中同时纳入VaR约束、交易成本和分散化正则化会导致非光滑、非凸的优化问题，现有DCA和BDCA等算法在收敛速度和求解质量上存在不足，需要设计更高效的算法。
AI.method: 利用有限场景VaR-CVaR恒等式，将原问题推导为凸组合集上的惩罚差分凸（DC）规划形式；提出投影惯性增强BDCA算法（iBDCA），结合惯性外推、目标值保护机制和增强线搜索；在局部无平局条件下证明全序列收敛及局部R-线性收敛率。
AI.result: 理论证明算法良定义、目标序列单调递减且聚点均为临界点；在局部无平局条件下全序列收敛并具有局部R-线性收敛率。数值实验表明iBDCA优于DCA和标准BDCA，样本外回测对比等权与买入持有基准揭示收益、风险、交易成本与VaR控制之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: iBDCA算法为求解带VaR约束的多期组合优化问题提供了高效且理论上可收敛的求解框架，数值实验验证了其在实际应用中的有效性和竞争性。

title: Best Response Dynamics for Zero-Sum Dynamic Games with Partial-Asymmetric Information
summary: This work studies a class of zero-sum stochastic linear quadratic dynamic games (LQDGs) under partial and asymmetric information. Information asymmetry introduces fundamental challenges related to \textit{belief representation} and \textit{theory of mind}, where players must impute belief states and estimates of other players to inform their strategies. Existing work highlights the difficulty of applying dynamic programming-like decomposition approach to these problems. An alternative approach based on \textit{best response dynamics} is proposed, which provides insights into belief representation and theory of mind challenges. Explicit expressions for each player's best response within the class of pure linear dynamic output feedback control strategies are derived, where the internal state dimension of each control is an integer multiple of the system state dimension. As players iteratively update their best responses, they form increasingly higher-order belief states, leading to infinite-dimensional internal states. However, numerical results reveal that the game's value converges after only a few iterations, suggesting that higher-order belief states provide vanishing benefit. This work further conducts numerical experiments to analyze the impact of asymmetric beliefs, belief orders, relative controllability and observability, and direct feed-through on a linear quadratic pursuit-evasion game's value.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部分且非对称信息下的一类零和随机线性二次动态博弈（LQDGs），提出基于最佳响应动态的方法来解决信息不对称带来的信念表示和心智理论挑战，推导出纯线性动态输出反馈控制策略下每个玩家的最佳响应显式表达式，并通过数值实验揭示高阶信念状态虽导致无限维内部状态，但游戏价值在几次迭代后即收敛，表明高阶信念收益递减。
AI.motivation: 信息不对称给零和随机线性二次动态博弈带来了信念表示和心智理论的根本性挑战，玩家必须推断其他玩家的信念状态和估计来制定策略。现有研究表明动态规划式的分解方法难以应用于此类问题，因此需要探索替代方法。
AI.method: 提出基于最佳响应动态的替代方法。推导了纯线性动态输出反馈控制策略类别内每个玩家的最佳响应显式表达式，其中每个控制器的内部状态维度是系统状态维度的整数倍。玩家迭代更新最佳响应会形成越来越高阶的信念状态，导致内部状态无限维化。通过数值实验分析非对称信念、信念阶数、相对可控性和可观测性以及直接馈通对博弈价值的影响。
AI.result: 数值结果表明博弈价值在仅仅几次迭代后就收敛，说明高阶信念状态带来的收益逐渐消失。此外，数值实验揭示了非对称信念、信念阶数、相对可控性和可观测性及直接馈通对线性二次追逃博弈价值的影响。
AI.conclusion: 最佳响应动态为部分非对称信息下的LQDGs提供了一种可行的求解框架，能够有效应对信念表示和心智理论挑战。尽管理论上需要无限维内部状态，但实际中低阶信念即可逼近博弈价值，具有重要的计算优势。

title: Recursive Filtering and Stochastic Control under Finite Partition-Based Observations
summary: We develop a filtering and optimal-control framework for partially observable stochastic systems in which each observation identifies a class of a finite measurable partition of the hidden state space. This structure covers regional-information mechanisms associated with threshold, quantized, censored, event-triggered, and intermittent observations, and allows observable classes with atomic, continuous, or mixed components. The formulation is constructed first at the level of measures: for each observable class, we define a class-restricted unnormalized conditional measure, and the posterior distribution is obtained by normalizing with its predictive probability. Based on this recursion, we introduce an information state consisting of the observed class and the conditional measure supported on it, thereby transforming the original problem into a fully observable Markov decision process. We formulate the discounted-cost criterion, derive the Bellman equation, and establish conditions for the existence of stationary optimal policies. To address the infinite-dimensional nature of the information space, we propose class-dependent finite-dimensional approximations capable of preserving both continuous components and atomic masses. We also derive an abstract bound linking the error of the approximate filter to the error of the value function. A reference model illustrates the construction through histogram-based approximations

AI.tldr: 本文为部分可观测随机系统提出了一个基于有限可测划分观测的滤波与最优控制框架，覆盖了阈值、量化、审查、事件触发和间歇观测等区域信息机制，并将原始部分可观测问题转化为完全可观测的马尔可夫决策过程，同时提出了类相关的有限维近似方法及误差界。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测随机控制系统中的观测往往不是完全信息，而是仅能识别隐藏状态所属的某个有限可测划分类（如阈值、量化、事件触发等区域信息机制）。现有方法缺乏一个统一的数学框架来同时处理这些结构，且可观测类中可能包含原子、连续或混合成分，导致滤波和最优控制问题在度量空间上具有无穷维复杂性。
AI.method: 首先在测度层面构造：对每个可观测类定义类受限的非归一化条件测度，通过其预测概率归一化得到后验分布。基于该递推关系构建信息状态（由已观测类和支撑在其上的条件测度组成），将原问题转化为完全可观测的马尔可夫决策过程。推导折扣成本准则下的贝尔曼方程，建立平稳最优策略存在性条件。针对信息空间的无穷维特性，提出类相关的有限维逼近方法以同时保留连续部分和原子质量，并推导近似滤波误差与值函数误差之间的抽象界限。
AI.result: 建立了统一的滤波-最优控制框架，提出了类相关有限维近似方案，得到了逼近误差到值函数误差的传递界限，并通过基于直方图近似的参考模型验证了该构造的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为覆盖多种区域信息观测机制的部分可观测随机系统提供了统一的滤波与最优控制方法论，其有限维近似方法在保留混合分布结构的同时保证了最优策略的可计算性。

title: Adjacency-Based Spectral Proxy Control of Mobile Communication Agents
summary:
We consider a heterogeneous mobile-agent network composed of uncontrolled task agents and controllable communication agents. The objective is to reposition communication agents online as task agents move. Since throughput-based objectives are generally unsuitable for real-time control, spectral graph metrics such as algebraic connectivity are commonly adopted as surrogate objectives. However, controlling algebraic connectivity relies on the eigenvector corresponding to the second-smallest eigenvalue of a graph's Laplacian matrix (i.e., the Fiedler vector), whose distributed estimation requires an unbounded number of communication rounds to converge.
  In this work, we identify a structural decomposition of this Fiedler-gradient controller into a local interaction rule and a graph embedding component, suggesting the use of alternative embeddings that are easier to estimate distributively than the Fiedler vector. As a particular instance, we propose A-Fiedler, which replaces the Fiedler embedding with the dominant eigenvector of the adjacency matrix, commonly used as a graph embedding of nodes into a latent geometry. This representation is more naturally suited for distributed implementation under local communication constraints.
  We evaluate A-Fiedler against the classical Fiedler-gradient controller. Results show comparable network performance in the absence of communication constraints and improved robustness under distributed estimation. For instance, under the same number of communication rounds, the Fielder-gradient may even converge to disconnected configurations whereas our proposition maintains performance. We believe our contribution provides a simpler path toward distributed network control.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异构移动代理网络（含不可控任务代理和可控通信代理）中的在线重定位问题，指出经典Fiedler梯度控制器依赖Fiedler向量（拉普拉斯矩阵第二小特征值对应特征向量）而难以分布式估计，提出一种结构分解视角，将控制器拆分为局部交互规则和图嵌入组件，并据此提出A-Fiedler方法——用邻接矩阵主特征向量替代Fiedler向量作为图嵌入。实验表明A-Fiedler在无通信约束时性能与传统方法相当，在分布式估计下鲁棒性更优。
AI.motivation: 吞吐量目标不适合实时控制，常采用代数连通性等谱图指标作为替代目标。但控制代数连通性依赖Fiedler向量，其分布式估计需要无限轮通信才能收敛，这在局部通信约束下不切实际。
AI.method: 首先对Fiedler梯度控制器进行结构分解，识别出局部交互规则和图嵌入两个组件；然后提出A-Fiedler方法，用邻接矩阵的主导特征向量（常用于节点到潜在几何空间的图嵌入）替代Fiedler向量作为图嵌入，从而更自然地适配分布式实现。
AI.result: 对比实验显示：在无通信约束下A-Fiedler与传统Fiedler梯度控制器性能相当；在分布式估计下，A-Fiedler鲁棒性更好。例如在相同通信轮数下，Fiedler梯度控制器可能收敛到不连通配置，而A-Fiedler能保持性能。
AI.conclusion: A-Fiedler为分布式网络控制提供了更简单的路径，在保持性能的同时显著提升了分布式实现下的鲁棒性。

title: Consistent Model Chasing Is Minimax Optimal: The Exact Value of Scalar Adversarial Adaptive Control under Large Parametric Uncertainty
summary: We solve exactly a fundamental problem of adaptive control against adversarial disturbances: regulate the scalar system $x_{t+1} = ax_t + u_t + w_t$, $x_0=0$, $\|w\|_\infty \le 1$, where the constant pole $a \in [-Δ, Δ]$ is unknown in sign and magnitude and $Δ$ is arbitrarily large. Elementary as the system looks, the least worst-case peak $\|x\|_\infty$ that a causal controller can guarantee against an adversarial pair $(a, w)$ (the value of this game) has, to our knowledge, never been determined for any adaptive control problem with parametric uncertainty of arbitrary size under this criterion; existing theory supplies stability certificates, gain bounds, and regret rates, not the value. That value is $γ^\star(Δ) = 1 + Δ$ for every $Δ>0$. The summand $1$ is the irreducible price of the disturbance, and $Δ$ the exact price of a single, unavoidable identification spike. The optimal policy is certainty-equivalent deadbeat control at the midpoint of the set-membership consistent interval, an instance of the robust oracle $\times$ consistent model chasing architecture. The architecture is forced, not merely sufficient: writing $θ_t := -u_t/x_t$ exhibits every causal controller as an oracle-selector composition, and optimality pins the selector to the midpoint at the critical histories. The standard tools, classical and modern, each fail quantifiably: probing is punished before it pays, commitment is fatal at sub-disturbance excitation once adaptation is necessary, optimism degenerates to tie-breaking or pays asymptotically at least twice the optimum, and regret certificates are blind to the worst-case peak in both directions. The optimal law contains no exploration mechanism, its learning purely passive. These results give the first exact optimality certificate for consistent model chasing as a design principle for adversarial adaptive control.

AI.tldr: 本文精确求解了一个对抗性扰动下自适应控制的基本问题：标量系统 x_{t+1}=ax_t+u_t+w_t，其中未知极点 a∈[-Δ,Δ]，Δ任意大。证明了最坏情况峰值 ||x||_∞ 的博弈值（最优控制器可保证的性能）为 γ^*(Δ)=1+Δ，其中 1 是扰动带来的不可约代价，Δ 是一次不可避免的识别尖峰的确切代价。最优策略是中点处的确定等价死区控制，属于鲁棒预言机×一致模型追逐架构，且该架构是被迫的而非仅充分。这是对一致模型追逐作为对抗自适应控制设计原则的首个精确最优性认证。
AI.motivation: 尽管标量线性系统在自适应控制中看似基础，但从未有人确定在参数不确定性任意大小、对抗性扰动下，最坏情况峰值响应的精确博弈值。现有理论仅提供稳定性证明、增益界和遗憾率，而非精确的性能值。作者旨在填补这一空白，回答"最优的因果控制器能够保证的最小最坏情况峰值是什么"。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为一个二人零和博弈，其中对抗者选择未知极点 a 和扰动序列 w。关键方法包括：(1) 通过定义 θ_t := -u_t/x_t，将任意因果控制器分解为"预言机-选择器"组合，证明该架构是必然的而非仅充分的；(2) 在临界历史处用最优性条件将选择器钉在中点上；(3) 对经典工具（探测、承诺、乐观、遗憾）逐一进行量化失败分析；(4) 最终建立值函数 γ^*(Δ)=1+Δ，最优策略为集合成员一致性区间中点的确定性等价死区控制。
AI.result: 证明了博弈值 γ^*(Δ)=1+Δ 对所有 Δ>0 成立。最坏情况峰值由两部分组成：扰动带来的不可约代价 1 和由单次不可避免的识别尖峰产生的代价 Δ。最优策略是中点处的确定等价死区控制（鲁棒预言机×一致模型追逐架构），它不含探索机制，学习纯粹是被动的。同时量化了经典工具的失败：探测在回报之前就受到惩罚，承诺在次扰动激励下是致命的，乐观方法退化为平局决定或渐近付出至少两倍最优代价，遗憾证书对最坏情况峰值双向失明。
AI.conclusion: 这一结果首次为一致模型追逐作为对抗自适应控制的设计原则提供了精确的最优性证书。它表明在该问题设定下，被动学习配合集合成员一致性区间中点控制不仅简单，而且严格最优——任何主动探索或复杂策略都无法改善最坏情况峰值性能。该工作为自适应控制的精确性能理论开辟了新的方向。

title: Nondegeneracy Conditions for Control Problems with Nonregular Mixed Constraints
summary: We establish nondegeneracy and normality conditions for optimal control problems with a single nonregular mixed inequality constraint, where purely finitely additive set functions (charges) appear as multipliers. We first prove for a model problem nonregular at a single instant that degeneration is intrinsic and unavoidable: every admissible process satisfies the necessary conditions degenerately via a pure charge, and normalized multipliers of natural regular approximations admit no weak$^*$ limit in $L^\infty([0,1];\mathbb{R})^*$, yielding only pure charges under every generalized limit, in the sense of Banach limits. Motivated by this analysis, we propose four verifiable conditions that progressively guarantee nondegenerate multipliers, the vanishing of the pure charge, normality, and explicit bounds on charge mass. Furthermore, we show that at a nonregular terminal instant, a balance identity ties the charge mass to the cost multiplier, deciding between complete abnormality and normality. We provide examples confirming the realizability and discussing the limits of each condition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带单个非正则混合不等式约束的最优控制问题中，乘子为纯有限可加集函数（charge）时的非退化性与正态性条件。证明了在模型问题非正则瞬间退化是内在且不可避免的，并提出四个可验证条件逐步保证非退化乘子、纯charge消失、正态性及charge质量显式界。
AI.motivation: 在非正则混合约束下，传统的最优控制必要条件的乘子可能退化为纯charge，而自然正则逼近的归一化乘子不存在L∞意义下的弱*极限。这种退化现象使经典的必要条件失去有效性，需要系统性地理解退化机制并提出可验证的非退化条件。
AI.method: 首先对单个时刻非正则的模型问题证明退化是本质且不可避免的，即每个容许过程都通过纯charge满足退化性必要条件，且正则逼近的归一化乘子在Banach极限意义下仅产生纯charge。随后提出四个逐级增强的可验证条件，分别保证非退化乘子、纯charge消失、正态性以及charge质量的显式上界。此外，在非正则末端时刻建立了将charge质量与成本乘子联系起来的平衡恒等式。
AI.result: 证明了模型问题中退化性无法避免；提出了四个渐进增强的可验证条件可分别实现非退化性、纯charge消除、正态性和charge界控；并推导出末端时刻的平衡恒等式，用于判定完全异常性与正态性。提供了实例验证各条件的可实现性并讨论其局限性。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了非正则混合约束下最优控制问题中纯charge乘子的出现机制，给出了从退化到正态的逐步充分条件，为处理非正则约束下的最优控制问题提供了理论工具和可验证准则。

title: hint$^2$: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
comment: Videos available on our project page: https://anonymous-hint2.github.io/
summary: A central goal of robot learning is to enable robots to execute rich instructions specified at runtime. Large-scale language-conditioned policies have made substantial progress toward this goal, yet still struggle with temporal structure and safety constraints. Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) provides a powerful language to express complex, non-Markovian instructions. However, guiding learned manipulation policies toward LTL satisfaction remains challenging because modern policies generate short-horizon action chunks and replan in closed loop, while almost all LTL specifications are evaluated over long-horizon trajectories. In this paper, we introduce hint$^2$, a method for guiding short-horizon policies toward satisfying complex LTL specifications at inference time using hierarchical world models. Our key idea is to derive two separate guidance objectives using each world model's abstraction level. A high-level model predicts future action-induced transitions in task-relevant atomic propositions to guide progress through the LTL automaton, while a low-level dynamics model predicts immediate state evolution for accurate local safety guidance. Our results show that hint$^2$ overcomes the limitations of current LTL-guided diffusion methods, outperforms existing inference-time steering methods in CALVIN, and successfully completes instructions with complex liveness and safety constraints more elegantly than language-conditioned alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that hint$^2$ can handle complex instructions on a real UR5e manipulator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出hint²方法，利用分层世界模型在推理时引导短视策略满足复杂线性时序逻辑（LTL）规范。高层模型预测任务相关原子命题的动作诱导转移以引导LTL自动机进度，低层动力学模型预测即时状态演化以进行局部安全引导。在CALVIN基准上优于现有推理时引导方法，并成功在真实UR5e机械臂上完成任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言条件策略在运行时执行丰富指令方面取得进展，但仍难以处理时间结构（长期依赖）和安全约束。尽管LTL能表达复杂的非马尔可夫指令，但现代策略生成短时域动作块并以闭环方式重规划，而几乎所有LTL规范都是在长时域轨迹上评估的，导致两者之间存在本质不匹配。
AI.method: hint²利用分层世界模型在推理时引导短视策略。该方法从每个世界模型的抽象层级导出两个独立的引导目标：1) 高层模型预测未来动作诱导的任务相关原子命题转移，用于引导LTL自动机的进度；2) 低层动力学模型预测即时状态演化，用于提供精确的局部安全引导。
AI.result: hint²克服了现有LTL引导扩散方法的局限性，在CALVIN基准上优于现有推理时引导方法，能够比语言条件基线更优雅地完成包含复杂活性（liveness）和安全约束的指令，并在真实UR5e机械臂上验证了复杂指令处理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层抽象分别处理长期任务进展和短期安全约束，hint²有效弥合了短视策略与长时域LTL规范之间的鸿沟，为推理时引导操作策略满足复杂时序逻辑提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Control Barrier--Value Functions under Partial Observability: Safety Guarantees via Conformal Prediction
summary: This paper studies safety analysis and controller synthesis for partially observable nonlinear control systems. We extend the control barrier--value function (CBVF) framework, which combines Hamilton--Jacobi reachability and control barrier functions, to settings where full state information is not available and control is based on an estimated state. Given an estimator, we apply conformal prediction to the estimation error and obtain an error bound at a user-chosen miscoverage level. We incorporate this bound into the estimator-space safety analysis and define a CBVF-based safety certificate for partially observable systems. We then derive a finite-horizon probabilistic safety guarantee for the true system state. Finally, we propose a QP-based online safety filter for systems affine in the control and disturbance, whose solution enforces the CBVF safety condition in real time against bounded disturbance. The proposed framework is illustrated on a partially observable obstacle-avoidance case study.

AI.tldr: 本文针对部分可观测非线性控制系统，将控制障碍-值函数（CBVF）框架扩展到基于估计状态的场景。利用共形预测获得估计误差界，在估计空间中建立安全证书，推导有限时域概率安全保证，并提出基于QP的在线安全滤波器。在部分可观测避障案例中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有CBVF框架结合了Hamilton-Jacobi可达性和控制障碍函数，但假设全状态可观测。现实系统中往往无法获得完整状态信息，控制器需基于估计状态工作，这给安全性分析与综合带来了新的挑战。
AI.method: 1) 给定估计器，利用共形预测（conformal prediction）对估计误差进行量化，在用户指定的误覆盖率水平下获得误差界；2) 将该误差界融入估计空间的安全分析，定义面向部分可观测系统的CBVF安全证书；3) 推导真实系统状态的有限时域概率安全保证；4) 针对控制和扰动仿射的系统，提出基于二次规划（QP）的在线安全滤波器，实时强制CBVF安全条件以抵御有界扰动。
AI.result: 通过部分可观测的避障案例研究验证了所提出框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将CBVF安全框架从全状态可观测扩展到部分可观测场景，利用共形预测为估计不确定性提供可调的统计保证，并实现了实时在线安全滤波，为基于估计器的不确定系统中安全控制提供了概率性保障方法。

title: First-Order Optimization as Minimum-Time Control
summary: We formulate first-order optimization as a minimum-time control problem. The iterate is the state, the update, a combination of the gradients observed so far, is the control, and the points with gradient norm at most a prescribed tolerance form the target set. For a fixed objective and start, the minimum number of oracle queries needed to reach the target is a value function: it measures the complexity of the instance, not the worst case over a class. On a strongly convex quadratic, the conjugate gradient iterates emerge from the discrete Pontryagin conditions, and the value is a controllability index. Beyond the quadratic, a Hessian-generated reachable span replaces the controllability matrix, and feasibility becomes a reachability question: whether a critical point can be reached at all, and in how many steps, is read from the span. Curvature is a resource: a checkable condition certifies that an instance needs fewer steps than the controllability index of its quadratic model at the minimizer, and the gap can grow without bound with the dimension. The value is thus a benchmark for the intrinsic difficulty of each instance, against which any first-order method can be measured.

AI.tldr: 该论文将一阶优化重新表述为最小时间控制问题，把迭代点视为状态、梯度组合视为控制、梯度范数阈值内的点视为目标集，从而将实例复杂度定义为值函数（最小查询次数），而非传统的最坏情况复杂度。在强凸二次型上，共轭梯度迭代自然从离散Pontryagin条件中涌现，值函数成为可控性指数；超越二次型后，Hessian生成的可达跨度替代了可控性矩阵，可行性变为可达性问题。论文还证明曲率是一种资源：存在可检验条件保证某些实例所需的步数少于其极小点处二次模型的可控性指数，且该差距可随维度无界增长。
AI.motivation: 传统一阶优化复杂度分析主要关注类上的最坏情况（worst-case）复杂度，但这种度量无法刻画单个实例的真实难度，导致算法评估与实例具体特征脱节。作者希望通过控制论视角将复杂度定义在实例层面，以更精确地揭示问题内在难度，并为任意一阶方法提供可比的基准。
AI.method: 将迭代框架建模为最小时间控制问题：状态为迭代点，控制为迄今观测到的梯度的组合更新，目标集为梯度范数不超过给定容差的点集。对固定目标函数和起点，到达目标所需的最小Oracle查询次数定义为值函数。在强凸二次形上利用离散Pontryagin极大值原理导出共轭梯度迭代，并以可控性指数解释值函数；对非二次情形，引入Hessian生成的可达跨度替代可控性矩阵，通过可达性判定临界点是否可达及可达步数。此外提出一个可检验条件，用于判定实例是否比其极小点处二次模型的可控性指数需要更少步数。
AI.result: 在强凸二次型上，共轭梯度迭代由离散Pontryagin条件自然涌现，值函数对应可控性指数。对于非二次目标，通过Hessian生成的可达跨度判断可行性（即临界点可达性与步数），并证明曲率是加速资源：存在可检验条件表明某些实例所需步数可少于对应二次模型的可控性指数，且该加速差距随维度增长可无界扩大。
AI.conclusion: 值函数为单个实例的内在难度提供了精确基准，使任何一阶方法都能被直接度量，超越了传统最坏情况分析框架。曲率被证明是一种可利用的资源，其对复杂度的改善可以随维度无界放大，为设计实例自适应的一阶优化算法提供了理论依据。

title: Graph-MambaNav: Spatial-Temporal Graph Mamba Leveraging Object-Relation Knowledge for Object-Goal Navigation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (IEEE RA-L), will transfer to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Object-goal navigation requires an agent to reason over object relationships and prioritize target-relevant objects for efficient decision making in unseen environments. While existing graph-based methods incorporate target-awareness at the feature or attention level, they remain permutation-invariant and lack an explicit mechanism to control information propagation order, limiting their ability to model target-dependent importance and long-range dependencies. In contrast, Graph-Mamba highlights that node prioritization through sequence ordering is critical for effective global reasoning. In this work, we investigate the node prioritization mechanism in Graph-Mamba and study its role in object navigation. We propose Graph-MambaNav, a target-aware spatial-temporal graph encoding framework that introduces a heuristic ordering over objects based on their relevance to the target, allowing more informative objects to be processed later to aggregate richer context. Both node ordering and edge weights are initialized from LLM-derived commonsense object relationships, providing a unified prior for structured reasoning. A spatial module integrates local message passing with global GraphMamba-based selective scanning, while a temporal module applies Mamba-based sequence modeling over object-wise temporal orders, allowing selective aggregation of historical context for long-range temporal reasoning. Experiments on AI2-THOR and RoboTHOR demonstrate improved navigation performance with generalization, and additional real-world robot deployment further validates the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出Graph-MambaNav，一种基于目标感知的时空图编码框架，通过LLM引导的节点排序（目标相关对象延迟处理以聚合更丰富上下文）和Mamba-based选择性扫描，解决目标导航中对象关系推理和长距离依赖问题，在AI2-THOR、RoboTHOR及真实机器人上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有图方法虽在特征或注意力层面融入目标感知，但保持排列不变性，缺乏对信息传播顺序的显式控制，难以建模目标依赖的重要性和长距离依赖。Graph-Mamba表明节点排序对全局推理至关重要，因此需要将节点优先级机制引入目标导航。
AI.method: 提出Graph-MambaNav框架：(1) 基于LLM常识对象关系初始化节点排序和边权重，按对象与目标的相关性进行启发式排序，使信息量更大的对象更晚处理以聚合更丰富上下文；(2) 空间模块结合局部消息传递与GraphMamba-based全局选择性扫描；(3) 时间模块采用Mamba-based序列建模，在对象级时间顺序上进行选择性历史上下文聚合以支持长距离时序推理。
AI.result: 在AI2-THOR和RoboTHOR基准上取得改进的导航性能与泛化能力，真实机器人部署进一步验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式控制节点处理顺序（基于LLM常识先验的目标相关性排序），并融合Mamba选择性扫描进行全局时空推理，Graph-MambaNav有效克服了传统图方法排列不变性的局限，为目标导航提供了可泛化的结构化推理方案。

title: Hierarchical Sensor-Spoofing Defence Framework for Networked DC Microgrids via Cyber-Physical Coordination
summary: In parallel to the cyber attack that manipulates the reference points of distributed energy resources (DERs) by maliciously accessing the remote monitoring and control system, the vulnerability of voltage/current sensors to electromagnetic interference (EMI) in the physical domain has been widely discussed. Existing research efforts against sensor spoofing attacks can be classified into physical prevention and cyber detection/mitigation. These defence methods each have strengths and weaknesses in balancing cost, security, and performance in a single DER, yet systematic research on their multi-layer efficient coordination across DERs remains limited. Towards this end, this paper proposes a hierarchical framework to detect and mitigate sensor spoofing attacks in networked microgrids (NMGs) via {multi-layer cyber-physical coordination}. It requires only to deploy physical prevention technologies at critical points, i.e., the local points of common coupling (PCC) of MGs, such that cyber detection/mitigation algorithms can be adopted based on the secured sensor readings to counter sensor spoofing attacks in DERs. The framework employs an MG-DER coordinated proactive detection scheme to strategically trigger parameter perturbations, under which the intelligent sensor spoofing attacks can be {effectively} disclosed. Afterwards, mitigation schemes based on MG-DER coordination are activated to recursively and accurately estimate sensor biases. Experiments on a cyber-physical DC NMG testbed confirm the framework's effectiveness across diverse attack scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层框架，通过多层网络-物理协调来检测和缓解网络化微电网（NMGs）中的传感器欺骗攻击。该框架仅在微电网的公共耦合点（PCC）部署物理防护技术，基于安全的传感器读数采用网络检测/缓解算法，并利用MG-DER协调的主动检测方案触发参数扰动以揭露智能传感器欺骗攻击，随后通过协调缓解方案递归估计传感器偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有针对传感器欺骗攻击的防御方法（物理防护和网络检测/缓解）在单个DER中各有优缺点，难以在成本、安全和性能之间取得平衡，且缺乏跨DER的多层高效协调的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出一个分层框架，仅在MG的PCC关键点部署物理防护技术，基于安全的传感器读数支撑网络检测/缓解算法；采用MG-DER协调的主动检测方案，通过策略性触发参数扰动揭露智能传感器欺骗攻击；随后激活基于MG-DER协调的缓解方案，递归且精确地估计传感器偏差。
AI.result: 在物理-网络DC NMG测试平台上进行了实验，验证了该框架在多种攻击场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该分层网络-物理协调框架能够以较低成本部署要求实现跨DER的传感器欺骗攻击的有效检测与缓解，为网络化微电网安全提供了系统性解决方案。

title: Benders Decomposition with Partial Non-Anticipativity Relaxation for Multi-Stage Stochastic Clean Energy Transition Planning
summary: We study clean energy transition planning for campus-scale integrated electricity-heat systems under both strategic level and operational level uncertainties. We formulate a multi-stage stochastic mixed-integer program that jointly optimizes investment and operational decisions for renewable generation, storage, and heat-transfer technologies whose costs and efficiencies evolve stochastically across stages. To account for short-term operational uncertainty, we further derive a robust reformulation based on box uncertainty sets for demand, renewable generation, and heat-transfer performance. To solve the resulting large-scale model, we develop a Benders decomposition algorithm with partial non-anticipativity relaxation. Investment variables and their non-anticipativity constraints are retained in the master problem while operational variables are assigned to scenario-wise subproblems where their non-anticipativity constraints are relaxed. Non-anticipativity of operational variables is restored only at termination through a smaller linear program. We prove that this correction step can only increase the objective function value by a finite bound. We improve the computational performance of the algorithm developed with valid inequalities and a two-phase cut-addition strategy. Using the proposed approach, we solve the Middle East Technical University campus case study at high temporal resolution within a reasonable computational budget, which is not otherwise possible with the extensive form or the classical Benders decomposition. We evaluate the resulting investment plans through rolling-horizon Monte Carlo simulations with an out-of-sample analysis and demonstrate that the added robustness can significantly improve the operational reliability of the transition plans with a moderate increase in total cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了校园级电-热综合能源系统在战略层和运营层双重不确定性下的清洁能源转型规划问题，提出了多阶段随机混合整数规划模型与带部分非预期性松弛的Benders分解算法，并通过中东技术大学校园案例验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 校园级综合电-热系统的清洁能源转型规划需要同时考虑战略层面的长期不确定性（技术成本和效率的随机演化）和运营层面的短期不确定性（需求、可再生能源出力、热传递性能的波动），现有方法难以在合理计算预算内求解如此大规模的组合优化问题。
AI.method: 构建多阶段随机混合整数规划模型联合优化投资与运营决策；基于箱式不确定性集合推导鲁棒重构以应对短期运营不确定性；开发部分非预期性松弛的Benders分解算法——投资变量及其非预期性约束保留在主问题中，运营变量分配给场景子问题并松弛其非预期性约束，终止时通过一个小规模线性规划恢复运营变量的非预期性，并证明该修正步骤只会使目标函数值增加有限界；通过有效不等式和两阶段割添加策略提升计算性能。
AI.result: 在中东技术大学校园案例中，所提方法能在合理计算预算内以高时间分辨率求解模型，而扩展形式或经典Benders分解无法做到。滚动时域蒙特卡洛模拟和样本外分析表明，增加的鲁棒性可显著提升转型计划的运营可靠性，同时总成本仅适度增加。
AI.conclusion: 提出的鲁棒多阶段随机优化框架和带部分非预期性松弛的Benders分解算法为校园级综合能源系统转型规划提供了一种高效且可靠的求解途径，在可接受的成本代价下实现了显著的可靠性提升。

title: Knowledge-Data-Dual-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Control in Mixed Traffic
summary: In mixed traffic, decision-making for autonomous vehicles (AVs) confronts three interrelated challenges. First, physics-based priors incorporated into reinforcement learning (RL) models fail to capture latent interactive vehicle intentions and diverse driver behaviors, limiting the proactive reasoning capabilities. Second, abrupt maneuvers by surrounding vehicles cause non-stationarity, leaving long-tail safety events under-explored. Third, hybrid action spaces destabilize unified RL training due to the different temporal scales of continuous car-following and discrete lane-changing maneuvers. To address these issues, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-driven Reinforcement Learning (KDDRL). First, a conditional deep generative model synthesizes intention-aware future trajectories, converting passive perception into proactive predictive states. Second, a knowledge-data dual-driven paradigm operates on these predictive states, fusing probabilistic data-driven insights with physical constraints to guide safe exploration through safety-critical scenarios. Third, a coupling module compresses both intention-aware trajectories and physical constraints into compact shared embeddings. This unified representation enables asynchronous multi-timescale optimization of continuous car-following and discrete lane-changing while preserving mutual information. Evaluations on dataset-calibrated simulations demonstrate that KDDRL effectively handles intention uncertainty, accelerates training convergence, and outperforms conventional baseline methods in terms of safety, efficiency, and comfort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识-数据双驱动强化学习（KDDRL）框架，解决混合交通中自动驾驶决策面临的意图不确定性、非平稳性及混合动作空间三大挑战，通过条件深度生成模型合成意图感知的未来轨迹，结合知识-数据双驱动范式与耦合模块实现连续跟车与离散换道的异步多时间尺度优化，在安全、效率和舒适性上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 混合交通中自动驾驶决策面临三个相互关联的挑战：（1）基于物理先验的强化学习模型无法捕捉潜在交互意图和多样化驾驶行为，限制了主动推理能力；（2）周围车辆的突然变道导致非平稳性，长尾安全事件未被充分探索；（3）连续跟车与离散换道具有不同时间尺度，混合动作空间使统一RL训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出KDDRL框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）条件深度生成模型合成意图感知的未来轨迹，将被动感知转化为主动预测状态；（2）知识-数据双驱动范式在这些预测状态上运行，融合概率数据驱动洞察与物理约束以引导安全探索；（3）耦合模块将意图感知轨迹和物理约束压缩为紧凑的共享嵌入，实现连续跟车与离散换道的异步多时间尺度优化并保持互信息。
AI.result: 在数据集校准的仿真中评估表明，KDDRL有效处理意图不确定性、加速训练收敛，并在安全性、效率和舒适性方面优于传统基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KDDRL通过双驱动范式和统一表示解决了混合交通中自动驾驶决策的意图建模、非平稳性及混合动作空间等关键挑战，为复杂交互场景下的安全决策提供了有效方案。

title: Real-Time In-Domain Congestion Control for the LWR Traffic Model via Control Barrier Functions
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to IEEE CDC 2026
summary: This paper presents a control barrier function-based method for real-time in-domain congestion control of the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards traffic model. Traffic congestion is formulated as a distributed safety control problem, leading to a infinite-dimensional optimization problem. Through the discretization and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) analysis, the problem is converted into a high-dimensional quadratic program. A structure-exploiting primal-dual active set algorithm is then developed to compute the safe control input in real time, with convergence guarantees. Numerical simulations with different nominal controllers demonstrate the effectiveness and real-time feasibility of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的实时域内拥塞控制方法，用于Lighthill-Whitham-Richards交通模型，将拥塞控制转化为分布式安全控制问题，通过离散化和KKT分析转化为高维二次规划，并开发了结构利用的主对偶有效集算法实现实时求解，数值仿真验证了方法的有效性和实时可行性。
AI.motivation: 交通拥塞是实际交通系统中的关键问题，需要实时有效的控制方法。Lighthill-Whitham-Richards模型作为经典的宏观交通流模型，其拥塞控制问题涉及无限维优化，难以直接实时求解，因此需要开发高效的算法来实现实时安全控制。
AI.method: 首先将交通拥塞表述为分布式安全控制问题，形成无限维优化问题；然后通过空间离散化和KKT（Karush-Kuhn-Tucker）条件分析，将无限维问题转化为高维二次规划（QP）；最后开发一种利用问题结构的主对偶有效集（primal-dual active set）算法，在保证收敛性的前提下实时计算安全控制输入。
AI.result: 通过使用不同名义控制器的数值仿真，验证了所提方法在交通拥塞控制方面的有效性，并证明了其具备实时求解的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将控制障碍函数方法推广到LWR交通模型的拥塞控制中，开发的结构化主对偶有效集算法能够在不牺牲实时性的前提下提供安全控制输入，为交通拥塞的实时控制提供了一种理论上有保证、计算上可行的解决方案。

title: Joint Inventory Placement, Assortment Personalization, and Order Fulfillment for Substitutable Products
summary: Modern online retailers leverage networks of distributed warehouses to rapidly fulfill customer orders. We study a problem of jointly deciding (i) how to allocate inventories across warehouses in the network subject to warehouse capacity and product supply constraints, (ii) how to dynamically select personalized product assortments based on customer preferences and location, as well as real-time stock levels, and (iii) which warehouse to use to fulfill the product chosen by the customer to maximize expected profit. In our model, the firm chooses an inventory placement across warehouses at the start of the selling horizon. Customers of different types then arrive at discrete time periods over a finite time horizon according to a known distribution. When offered an assortment, each customer type chooses at most one product according to a discrete choice model. The firm then chooses a feasible warehouse from which to fulfill the chosen product, depleting its stock and earning a profit that depends on the product, customer type, and warehouse choice. We develop approximation algorithms and policies with provable theoretical guarantees and strong empirical performance. Under general probabilistic choice models, we establish asymptotically optimal approximation algorithms as warehouse capacities and product supplies scale. Under the multinomial logit (MNL) choice model, we obtain constant-factor approximation algorithms, with approximation factors ranging from 0.080 in the most general setting to 0.199 under stationarity and unlimited product supplies, which means that only warehouse capacity constraints are present. To the best of our knowledge, these results provide the first provably efficient algorithms for the joint inventory placement, assortment personalization, and order fulfillment problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线零售商在分布式仓储网络中的联合优化问题，同时决策库存分配、个性化商品推荐和订单履约，提出了具有理论保证的近似算法，在多项式罗吉特（MNL）选择模型下获得常数因子近似比。
AI.motivation: 现代在线零售商依赖分布式仓储网络快速履约订单。然而，库存分配、个性化商品推荐和订单履约这三个关键决策相互耦合，此前缺乏统一的模型和高效求解算法。本文旨在提出一个联合优化框架，并设计可证明高效的算法来解决这一复杂问题。
AI.method: 构建一个联合决策模型：销售期初确定各仓库的库存配置（受容量和供应约束），随后在有限时间范围内按已知分布离散到达不同类型顾客，顾客根据离散选择模型从推荐集合中至多选择一种商品，企业再从可行仓库中选择履约仓库以获取利润。针对一般概率选择模型，提出随仓库容量和产品供应规模扩展的渐近最优近似算法；针对MNL选择模型，提出常数因子近似算法。
AI.result: 在一般概率选择模型下，建立了渐近最优的近似算法。在MNL选择模型下，获得常数因子近似比，最一般设定下为0.080，在平稳性和产品供应无限的设定下（仅存在仓库容量约束）达到0.199。这是首次为库存放置、个性化推荐与订单履约联合问题提供可证明高效算法。
AI.conclusion: 本文为分布式仓储网络下的库存分配、个性化推荐和订单履约联合优化问题提供了首个具有理论保证的高效算法框架，在一般选择模型和MNL模型下分别实现渐近最优和常数因子近似，兼具理论可行性与强实证表现。

title: Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems
summary: EV-WM represents candidate quality with feature and event scores, but these scores do not explicitly record an unmet task predicate, a route label for an available correction mechanism, or a post-correction acceptance result. We present Onto-EV-WM, an ontology-grounded diagnosis and verification-gated correction interface layered above EV-WM rather than a replacement world-model architecture. The implemented task-local TBox defines entity types, predicate signatures, and constraints; source-specific grounding maps predicted or simulator-observed states to task ABoxes; and deterministic rules retain each missing predicate and its arguments when assigning a route label. Learned or heuristic proposers remain separate from this symbolic interface; native task predicates determine acceptance, and the bounded protocol determines whether a failed verification is retried. In the aligned PointMaze evaluation, EV-WM and Onto-EV-WM both report 94% success, with mean final-state distances of 0.90573 and 0.61177, respectively; the separately budgeted search reaches 100% success. On LIBERO-Goal, the ontology represents failed task conditions as typed records, retains their predicate arguments, and associates them with the declared source/joint correction route and predicate-gated acceptance; the complete configuration reports 93.8% corrected-window success on seed 0 and 94.05 +- 0.30% across four evaluation-sampling seeds. On the fixed 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus registry, Onto-EV-WM succeeds on 8,526 tasks (85.00%), with suite-level success rates of 65.98% for LIBERO-10, 91.39% for LIBERO-Goal, and 91.38% for both LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial. These numbers report the performance of the complete ontology-grounded configurations under the tested simulator protocols; an ontology-only causal share is not measured separately, and real-robot recovery is not evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Onto-EV-WM，一个基于本体论（ontology）的诊断与验证门控纠正接口，叠加在EV-WM之上而非替代其世界模型架构。它通过任务局部TBox定义实体类型和谓词签名，用确定性规则记录缺失谓词及其参数并分配路由标签，通过谓词门控的验证协议决定是否重试。在PointMaze、LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Plus基准上报告了88%-94%的成功率。
AI.motivation: EV-WM虽然用特征分数和事件分数表示候选质量，但未显式记录未满足的任务谓词、可用纠正机制的路由标签，以及纠正后的接受结果。缺乏这些显式信息导致诊断不透明、纠正不可追溯，因此需要一个更高层接口来补足这些语义信息。
AI.method: Onto-EV-WM由三个组件构成：(1) 任务局部TBox定义实体类型、谓词签名和约束；(2) 源特定grounding映射将预测或模拟器观测状态转换为任务ABox；(3) 确定性规则在分配路由标签时保留每个缺失谓词及其参数。学习型或启发式proposer与该符号接口分离；原生任务谓词决定接受，有界协议决定验证失败时是否重试。
AI.result: 在PointMaze评估中，EV-WM和Onto-EV-WM均报告94%成功率，平均终态距离分别为0.90573和0.61177，单独预算的搜索达100%。在LIBERO-Goal上，完整配置在种子0上报告93.8%纠正窗口成功率，四个评估采样种子上为94.05±0.30%。在固定的10,030任务LIBERO-Plus注册表上，Onto-EV-WM成功8,526个任务（85.00%），LIBERO-10为65.98%，LIBERO-Goal为91.39%，LIBERO-Object和LIBERO-Spatial均为91.38%。
AI.conclusion: 这些数字报告了完整本体grounded配置在测试模拟器协议下的性能；本体单独的因果贡献未被单独测量，真实机器人恢复也未评估。Onto-EV-WM通过在EV-WM之上增加显式的语义诊断与验证门控层，改善了纠正的透明度与可追溯性。

title: Feedback-Guided DNN-Based Controller Fusion for Robust Fixed-Parameter Active Noise Control
summary: In active noise control (ANC) systems, adaptive approaches may suffer from instability or divergence, limiting their practical deployment. Consequently, fixed-parameter controllers are widely adopted, but their performance degrades under varying noise characteristics and acoustic path conditions. This paper proposes a feedback-guided DNN-based controller fusion framework for robust fixed-parameter ANC. The proposed method combines a causal WaveNet controller with a feedback-guided mixture-of-experts (MoE) module, where a gating network estimates the weights of multiple pre-trained FIR experts according to the current acoustic condition. The proposed approach improves robustness to varying acoustic conditions without online parameter updating. Furthermore, the model is fully causal and supports sample-wise streaming inference, with computational costs evenly distributed across sampling points to reduce peak computational load. Experimental results on headphone ANC demonstrate substantial low-frequency noise reduction with negligible noise amplification over 1-8 kHz.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于反馈引导的DNN控制器融合框架，用于鲁棒的固定参数主动噪声控制（ANC）。该方法结合因果关系WaveNet控制器与反馈引导的混合专家（MoE）模块，通过门控网络根据当前声学条件估计多个预训练FIR专家的权重，在无需在线参数更新的情况下提升对不同声学条件的鲁棒性。模型完全因果且支持逐样本流式推理，计算开销均匀分布在采样点上以降低峰值计算负载。耳机ANC实验结果表明，该方法在低频段实现了显著的降噪效果，同时在1-8 kHz频段噪声放大可忽略不计。
AI.motivation: 自适应ANC方法可能遭受不稳定性或发散问题，限制了实际部署；而固定参数控制器在噪声特性和声学路径条件变化时性能显著下降。因此需要一种既保持固定参数部署的稳定性，又能适应变化声学条件的鲁棒ANC方案。
AI.method: 提出反馈引导的DNN控制器融合框架，包含两部分：(1) 因果关系WaveNet控制器作为主干；(2) 反馈引导的混合专家（MoE）模块，其中门控网络根据当前声学条件（通过反馈信号估计）动态分配多个预训练FIR专家的权重。模型完全因果，支持逐样本流式推理，并通过将计算量均匀分布到各采样点来降低峰值计算负载。
AI.result: 在耳机ANC实验上，该方法在低频段实现了显著的降噪效果，同时在1-8 kHz范围内几乎没有噪声放大，验证了在变化声学条件下无需在线参数更新即可保持鲁棒性能的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 反馈引导的MoE融合机制有效解决了固定参数ANC控制器在声学条件变化时的性能退化问题，在保持计算高效和流式推理能力的同时实现了鲁棒降噪，为ANC系统的实用化部署提供了一种有前景的方案。

title: Diffusion-Based Policies for Dynamic Control of Stochastic Processing Networks
summary:
We consider a processing network model with $m$ job classes or buffers, exogenous input flows into some classes, $n$ processing activities, and $p$ servers. Each activity is either a specified server processing jobs of a specified class, or a fictional input server delivering jobs of a specified class; jobs change class in Markovian fashion after completing service. A standard multiclass queueing network, with its one-to-one correspondence between job classes and activities, is a special case, but our general model allows two or more ways to process a given class, and some or all input flows may be turned away at the system manager's discretion.
  Costs are linear: a holding cost per time unit for each class $i$ job in the system, and a rejection penalty for each class $i$ arrival denied access $(i=1,\ldots,m)$. The system manager makes input control, job routing, and order-of-service decisions to minimize expected discounted costs over an infinite horizon.
  We formulate an approximating Brownian control problem (BCP) whose state space is the $m$-dimensional nonnegative orthant; control is a drift vector chosen from a bounded polyhedral set, based on dynamic state observations. Using recently developed computational methods, the BCP can be solved numerically in dimensions up to at least $m=50$, and we explain how the numerical solution is translated into an implementable control policy for the queueing system of original interest.
  Previous work on heavy traffic diffusion approximations suggests that this policy is nearly optimal in the heavy traffic parameter regime, and numerical examples support that conjecture. We also discuss its advantage over an alternative approach, featured in our previous work, where the BCP is replaced by a lower-dimensional "equivalent workload formulation" that is computationally efficient but difficult to interpret in the network of original interest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的多类排队网络布朗控制问题（BCP）求解方法，允许同一类工作有多种处理方式、可拒绝输入流，通过数值求解高维BCP并将其转化为可实施的调度策略，在重流量参数区域内近似最优。
AI.motivation: 实际排队网络通常有多类工作、多种处理方式以及可拒绝的输入流，但现有的近似控制方法要么计算效率低、要么难以在原网络中解释。需要一种既能在高维（m≥50）下高效求解，又能产生可理解可实施的策略的方法。
AI.method: 将原始排队网络建模为布朗控制问题（BCP），其状态空间为m维非负象限，控制为从有界多面体集中选择的漂移向量，基于动态状态观测。利用近期开发的数值计算方法求解BCP（维度可达m=50），并将数值解转化为原排队系统中可实施的控制策略。
AI.result: 数值例子支持该策略在重流量参数区域内近似最优的猜想；与之前基于低维"等效工作负载公式"的方法相比，该方法虽计算成本更高但更易于在原网络中解释和实施。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的BCP数值求解及策略转化方法为多类、多重处理方式、可拒绝输入流的排队网络提供了一条可行的近似最优控制途径，兼具高维可计算性和策略可解释性。

title: Communication in modular robotic motor control: Bilateral controllers under realistic constraints
summary: Robotic motor control in musculoskeletal systems requires fast, accurate movement and robust postural stabilization under signal-dependent noise (where motor command variance scales with command magnitude) and energetic cost. Modular controllers can distribute these competing demands across interacting submodules, but it remains unclear whether they outperform monolithic architectures under realistic constraints, and how inter-module communication shapes the resulting strategy. Inspired by the bilateral hemispheric organization of the brain, we introduce a recurrent controller of two GRU-based modules connected by a learnable, delayed inter-hemispheric channel, trained end-to-end in a differentiable two-arm musculoskeletal simulator. Across reaching and holding tasks, the modular architecture substantially outperforms a capacity-matched monolithic baseline. Compared to a matched modular controller without communication, learned inter-hemispheric communication reshapes the solution: improved endpoint precision, lower energetic cost in non-zero-delay regimes, and reduced muscle co-contraction. Our findings show that for robotics, biologically inspired modular controllers offer a practical route to robust movement under noise and energetic constraints, with inter-module communication providing a mechanism to tune trade-offs between precision, stability, and actuation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受大脑双侧半球组织启发的模块化循环控制器，由两个GRU模块通过可学习的延迟半球间通道连接，在可微分的双臂肌肉骨骼模拟器中端到端训练。实验表明该模块化架构在到达和保持任务中显著优于同等容量的单体架构，且学习到的半球间通信可通过调节肌肉共收缩来改善末端精度并降低能量消耗。
AI.motivation: 肌肉骨骼系统中的机器人运动控制需要在信号依赖噪声和能量成本约束下同时实现快速准确运动和鲁棒姿态稳定。模块化控制器有望通过子模块间交互来分配这些竞争性需求，但模块化架构是否在现实约束下优于单体架构、以及模块间通信如何影响控制策略尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用受大脑双侧半球组织启发的架构：一个由两个GRU模块组成的循环控制器，通过可学习的延迟半球间通道连接。该控制器在可微分的双臂肌肉骨骼模拟器中端到端训练，并在到达和保持任务中与容量匹配的单体基线以及无通信的模块化控制器进行对比。
AI.result: 模块化架构在到达和保持任务中显著优于容量匹配的单体基线。与无通信的模块化控制器相比，学习到的半球间通信改进了末端精度、在非零延迟条件下降低了能量成本，并减少了肌肉共收缩。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发的模块化控制器为机器人在噪声和能量约束下的鲁棒运动控制提供了实用途径，模块间通信提供了一种在精度、稳定性和驱动成本之间调节权衡的机制。

title: A Temporal Barrier Framework for Collision Avoidance in Multi-Agent Autonomous Aerial Vehicles
summary: Operating teams of autonomous aircraft in dynamic, uncertain, and potentially adversarial environments requires safety protocols that are reliable yet selective, and allow agents to fly in close proximity while making progress toward mission objectives. We introduce adversarial time-to-collision (aTTC), a risk metric that quantifies, for a given agent, how quickly any surrounding agent could reach it assuming adversarial intent. We embed aTTC into the control barrier function (CBF) framework, defining the barrier directly in time rather than distance or velocity. The resulting aTTC-CBF is inherently anticipatory: agents modulate their own velocity based not on whether a peer is on a collision course, but on how quickly one could reach collision given its dynamical constraints. A differentiable neural-network surrogate makes the aTTC computable in real time within a standard CBF quadratic program. Across long time-horizon simulations of 3D independent-pursuit and formation-flight scenarios, the aTTC-CBF achieves up to twice the waypoint progress at half the collision rate of a higher-order distance-based CBF baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗性碰撞时间（aTTC）风险度量，并将其嵌入控制障碍函数（CBF）框架中，形成以时间而非距离或速度定义的aTTC-CBF，使自主飞行器编队在动态、不确定、对抗性环境中既能安全飞行又能高效完成任务。实验表明其航点进度提升两倍、碰撞率降低一半。
AI.motivation: 在动态、不确定且可能对抗的环境中运营自主飞行器编队，需要既可靠又具选择性的安全协议，使代理能在近距离飞行同时推进任务目标。传统的基于距离或速度的CBF安全屏障往往过于保守，限制了任务进度。
AI.method: 提出aTTC风险度量，量化给定代理被任意周围代理在假设对抗意图下最快被触及的时间；将其嵌入CBF框架，直接在时间域定义屏障而非距离或速度域；利用可微神经网络代理使aTTC可在标准CBF二次规划中实时计算。
AI.result: 在3D独立追逐和编队飞行场景的长时域仿真中，aTTC-CBF相比基于高阶距离的CBF基线，实现了最多两倍的航点进度，同时碰撞率降低一半。
AI.conclusion: aTTC-CBF具有固有的预见性，代理根据对手在其动力学约束下能够多快到达碰撞来调节自身速度，而非仅判断是否处于碰撞航线上，从而在安全性与任务效率之间实现更优平衡。

title: Optimal Control with $L^\infty$ and Integral Cost Functionals
summary:
Many control problems are classically formulated using integral costs that capture the cumulative performance of a system. Peak or worst-case behavior is captured via supremum or $L^\infty$-costs in another variety of control problems. When both cumulative and peak performance are important, it is natural to consider objective functions that combine the two costs. Although each criterion is well studied, their combination has not been explored extensively and we precisely work on such control problems.
  Towards establishing the existence, we first consider the relaxed framework, where control is considered using probability distributions. Using the well-known compactness and convexity properties of such control spaces, we establish the existence of an optimal relaxed control---we eventually establish the existence of an $ε$-optimal pure (or classical) control, for every $ε> 0.$
  Despite these existence results, computing optimal policies remains challenging due to the non-smoothness introduced by the supremum term, and it is not clear whether the dynamic programming principle holds for our combined problem. To address this, we introduce a family of smooth approximations that yield standard control problems with well-defined optimal (pure) solutions. Using Maximum Theorem, we establish that the solutions of the smooth problems among pure controls form $ε$-optimal for the original problem, with $ε$ tending to zero as the smoothing parameter converges to zero.
  Finally using the methods proposed in this paper, we study a queueing problem to illustrate (among others) that the required trade-off between peak congestion levels and cumulative performance can be achieved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同时包含累积成本（积分成本）和峰值成本（上确界/L∞成本）的混合最优控制问题，建立最优解的存在性并通过光滑逼近方法构造ε-最优纯控制解，最后在排队问题中验证了该方法可在峰值拥堵与累积性能之间实现权衡。
AI.motivation: 经典控制问题通常分别处理累积性能（积分成本）或峰值/最坏情况性能（上确界成本），但实际系统中两者往往同样重要。虽然每种准则已被充分研究，但二者的组合控制问题尚未被广泛探索，本文正是针对这类组合目标的控制问题开展研究。
AI.method: 首先在松弛控制框架下利用概率分布的控制空间，借助其紧致性和凸性建立最优松弛控制的存在性，进而证明对任意ε>0存在ε-最优纯（经典）控制。针对由上确界项引起的非光滑性导致动态规划原理不成立的问题，引入一族光滑逼近将原问题转化为标准控制问题，并利用最大性定理（Maximum Theorem）证明光滑问题的最优解构成原问题的ε-最优解。
AI.result: 建立了组合成本控制问题的最优解存在性；证明了光滑逼近问题的解对原问题构成ε-最优解，且当光滑参数趋于零时ε趋于零；在排队问题中验证了所提方法能够实现峰值拥堵水平与累积性能之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文为同时考虑累积与峰值性能的组合成本控制问题提供了系统的存在性理论和可计算的近似求解方法，并通过排队问题展示了其实际应用价值。

title: BICPO-VLA: Behavior-Identified Continuation Preference Optimization for Smooth Asynchronous Vision-Language-Action Control
summary: The request-to-handoff gap has three coupled sources: ambiguity about the behavior intended at request time, physical-state drift accumulated during action generation, and residual incompatibility when the new action finally assumes control. BICPO-VLA addresses them in sequence. First, an instruction-aware causal history encoder identifies the behavior supported by the command and current task progress. Second, sequential Haar subspace generation decomposes each action chunk into complementary pairwise scaffold and residual coefficients, enabling two specialized generation stages followed by exact reconstruction. By reducing iterative refinement in the original action space, it shortens the interval over which the robot continues moving before the new chunk becomes available. Finally, BICPO rolls the known outgoing actions to the actual handoff state and applies reference-relative Flow-DPO among behaviorally matched candidates, adapting the generated chunk to the remaining request-to-handoff mismatch without changing its intended behavior.

AI.tldr: BICPO-VLA通过指令感知的因果历史编码、序贯Haar子空间生成和参考相对Flow-DPO三个步骤，依次解决机器人请求到手部交接（request-to-handoff）间隙中的行为歧义、物理状态漂移和残余不兼容三个耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 请求到手部交接间隙存在三个耦合来源：请求时的行为意图歧义、动作生成过程中的物理状态漂移、以及新动作最终接管控制时的残余不兼容性。现有方法未系统性地解决这些耦合问题。
AI.method: BICPO-VLA按顺序处理三个问题：1) 指令感知的因果历史编码器识别指令和任务进度所支持的行为；2) 序贯Haar子空间生成将每个动作块分解为互补的成对脚手架和残差系数，通过两个专门的生成阶段后精确重构，减少原始动作空间的迭代细化，缩短机器人在新动作块可用前继续移动的时间间隔；3) 将已知的离场动作滚动到实际交接状态，并在行为匹配的候选中应用参考相对Flow-DPO，使生成的块适应剩余的交接不匹配而不改变其意图行为。
AI.result: 通过缩短原动作空间中的迭代细化过程，减少了新动作块可用前机器人继续移动的时间间隔，并通过参考相对Flow-DPO在行为匹配候选中实现动作适配，从而缓解交接不匹配。
AI.conclusion: BICPO-VLA通过解耦三个耦合源并逐一解决，实现更平滑、更准确的机器人动作交接，在保持行为意图的同时减少交接间隙。

title: Diagonalizable Directed Laplacians by Positive Arc-Weight Design for Master Stability Analysis
summary: The standard master stability function (MSF) formulation has traditionally relied on a diagonalizable network Laplacian, since diagonalizability allows the variational equations to be decomposed into independent equations. Directed Laplacians, however, need not be diagonalizable. We show that every weakly connected digraph admits a strictly positive arc weighting for which its weighted in-degree Laplacian is diagonalizable. Our construction first extracts a weakly connected spanning directed acyclic graph having exactly one source vertex in each root strongly connected component and assigns positive weights so that the weighted indegrees of all remaining vertices are pairwise distinct. The remaining arcs of the original digraph are then assigned a common sufficiently small positive weight. The nonzero eigenvalues remain pairwise distinct under this perturbation, while the zero eigenvalue is semisimple, with multiplicity equal to the number of root strongly connected components. Consequently, the resulting Laplacian admits a complete set of eigenvectors and restores the fully decoupled form of the MSF variational equations. We further give a discriminant-based criterion for computing an admissible interval of the common arc weight.

AI.tldr: 本文证明每个弱连通有向图都存在一个严格正弧加权，使其加权入度拉普拉斯矩阵可对角化，从而恢复主稳定函数（MSF）变分方程的完全解耦形式。
AI.motivation: 传统MSF公式依赖网络拉普拉斯矩阵可对角化，从而将变分方程分解为独立方程。但有向图的拉普拉斯矩阵不一定可对角化，这限制了MSF方法在有向网络中的应用。作者旨在通过构造合理的弧加权方案，使得有向图的拉普拉斯矩阵可对角化。
AI.method: 提出一个两步构造方法：首先从弱连通有向图中提取一个弱连通的有向无环生成子图，使得每个根强连通分量恰好有一个源顶点，并为这些弧赋正权使其余顶点的加权入度两两不同；随后将原图剩余弧赋予一个共同的足够小的正权。通过扰动分析保证非零特征值两两不同，同时零特征值半单，重数等于根强连通分量数。作者还基于判别式给出了共同弧权可取值区间的计算准则。
AI.result: 该构造方法保证所得拉普拉斯矩阵具有完整的特征向量集，即存在N个线性无关的特征向量，从而恢复了MSF变分方程的完全解耦形式，使MSF分析能够适用于一般的弱连通有向网络。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理的弧加权方案，可以克服有向网络拉普拉斯矩阵不可对角化的障碍，使得主稳定函数方法得以推广到更广泛的网络拓扑，并为实际应用中共同弧权的选取提供了判别式准则。

title: Optimizing bounds for energy-constrained optimal cooling problems in two dimensions
summary: We study optimal control problems for incompressible fluids in two-dimensional domains with a cold boundary and internal heat sources and sinks. Given a kinetic energy budget, measured by the square of a nondimensional Péclet number $\mathrm{Pe}$, the goal is to maximize a cooling efficiency inversely proportional to the mean square gradient of the fluid's temperature. Using Lagrange duality, we formulate a well-posed dual problem whose solution yields an upper bound on the maximum cooling efficiency $\mathcal{E}(\mathrm{Pe})$. We then numerically approximate the dual problem using a convergent hierarchy of semidefinite programs obtained via discretization. We illustrate this computational approach on optimal cooling problems in a square and in an annulus, explaining also how problem symmetries can be exploited to reduce computational complexity. Finally, we construct admissible points for the dual problem to obtain new analytical upper bounds on the optimal cooling efficiency $\mathcal{E}(\mathrm{Pe})$. Specifically, we prove that $\mathcal{E}(\mathrm{Pe}) \lesssim \mathrm{Pe}^{2}$ for arbitrary domains and heat distributions, and that $\mathcal{E}(\mathrm{Pe})\lesssim \mathrm{Pe}^{2}/ \ln^2\mathrm{Pe}$ for cooling flows in disks and annuli with heat source/sink distributions with a positive azimuthal average. These results generalize and improve known efficiency bounds for energy-constrained cooling flows in a disk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维不可压缩流体最优冷却控制问题，通过拉格朗日对偶建立良定的对偶问题，用半定规划层次法数值求解，并给出新的解析上界：任意域中冷却效率不超过 Pe²，而在圆盘/环域中可改进为 Pe²/ln²Pe。
AI.motivation: 为能量受限的冷却流动问题（冷边界+内部热源/热汇）提供新的冷却效率上界，并推广和改进了现有关于圆盘中冷却流动的已知效率界。
AI.method: 利用拉格朗日对偶构造良定的对偶问题以获得冷却效率上界；通过离散化构造收敛的半定规划（SDP）层次法进行数值逼近，并利用问题对称性降低计算复杂度；同时构造对偶问题的可行点以获得新的解析上界。
AI.result: 在任意域和热分布下证明了 E(Pe) ≲ Pe²，且在圆盘和环域中当热源/热汇分布具有正方位角平均时，改进为 E(Pe) ≲ Pe²/ln²Pe。数值实验在方形和环形域上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的对偶+SDP数值框架能有效计算最优冷却效率上界，新解析界推广并改进了已有圆盘结果，对一般域提供了统一的 Pe² 界。

title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
summary: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands, and parallel grippers. Finally, we use domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific information in the learned visual representation. Experiments on hand-action prediction and real-world dexterous manipulation show consistent improvements over baselines, effective zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer, generalization to unseen objects and environments, and data-efficient few-shot adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvDex，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过大规模人类操作演示数据集OmniShare、规范的联合对齐动作空间（JAAS）和域对抗学习，实现跨形态的灵巧操作学习与零样本人-机器人技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作是具身智能的基础能力，但规模化仍面临两大挑战：机器人演示数据收集成本高昂，且不同机器人形态的动作空间各异；此外，在异构数据上训练的策略会将与任务相关的视觉线索与形态特定的外观特征纠缠在一起，限制跨形态泛化能力。
AI.method: AdvDex包含三个核心组件：(1) OmniShare，一个大规模多模态人类操作演示数据集，提供高质量运动学监督和触觉测量，减少对机器人遥操作的依赖；(2) 联合对齐动作空间（JAAS），一种规范动作表示，包含SE(3)腕部姿态和15个手指关节，从而在功能上对齐人类手、灵巧机器手和平行夹爪；(3) 域对抗学习，用于减少所学视觉表示中的形态特定信息。
AI.result: 在手部动作预测和真实世界灵巧操作实验中，AdvDex相比基线方法取得了一致的性能提升，实现了有效的零样本人到机器人技能迁移、对未见物体和环境的泛化，以及数据高效的少样本适应。
AI.conclusion: AdvDex通过结合大规模人类演示数据、规范动作空间和域对抗视觉学习，有效解决了灵巧操作跨形态泛化的核心问题，为具身智能的灵巧操作规模化提供了可行路径。

title: Optimal Scheduling of Road Maintenance Jobs Considering Impact on Traffic Flows
comment: Case Study paper presented in IISE Annual Conference and Expo 2026
summary: Network-level maintenance planning requires repeated evaluations of equilibrium traffic flows under road capacity reductions. While equilibrium traffic assignment models are well established, their repeated solution quickly becomes computationally prohibitive and challenging to embed within maintenance scheduling problems. This paper investigates data-driven surrogate models that approximate equilibrium arc flows directly from origin-destination demand, using optimization-based equilibrium solutions as ground truth. A real-world case study based on traffic data from the Newark, New Jersey area demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach as a scalable building block for future maintenance scheduling frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了用数据驱动代理模型直接近似均衡弧流量，以替代重复求解均衡交通分配模型，从而支持网络级养护规划的优化调度。基于新泽西州纽瓦克地区的真实交通数据验证了方法的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 网络级养护规划需要在道路能力下降的情况下反复评估均衡交通流，而均衡交通分配模型的重复求解在计算上代价高昂，难以嵌入养护调度优化问题中，因此亟需高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动的代理模型，直接从起讫点（OD）需求近似均衡弧流量，以基于优化的均衡解作为地面真值进行训练和验证。
AI.result: 基于新泽西纽瓦克地区的真实交通数据案例研究表明，所提出的代理模型方法能够有效逼近均衡弧流量，并具备良好的可扩展性，可作为未来养护调度框架的构建模块。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动代理模型是替代重复均衡交通分配计算的可行且可扩展的方案，为将交通流评估嵌入网络级养护调度优化问题提供了有效支撑。

title: A Shrinkage Path Heuristic for Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization
summary: Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization (DRO) is a versatile and widely adopted framework for decision-making under uncertainty, yet its standard deterministic reformulations generally contain non-convex inner subproblems that are challenging to solve. To address this issue, we propose a shrinkage path heuristic that reduces the solution of a DRO problem to a one-dimensional search over the line segment connecting the (typically benign) sample average approximation (SAA) and the (more demanding but practically solvable) classical robust optimization solution. We derive a priori suboptimality bounds in stylized settings and, for the general case, a posteriori bounds obtained by applying a similar heuristic to a dual formulation. Numerical experiments on a multi-item newsvendor and an appointment scheduling problem show that the shrinkage path heuristic attains 85-110% (resp. 45-70%) of the out-of-sample performance improvements of Wasserstein DRO over SAA, at a fraction of the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种收缩路径启发式方法，将Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化（DRO）问题简化为在SAA解与经典鲁棒优化解之间的线段上的一维搜索，在显著降低计算成本的同时，能在多商品报童和预约调度问题中实现Wasserstein DRO相较于SAA的大部分样本外性能提升。
AI.motivation: Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化（DRO）是处理不确定决策问题的常用框架，但其标准确定性重构中包含非凸的内层子问题，求解困难。现有方法计算代价高昂，亟需一种既能降低计算复杂度又能保持较好性能的求解策略。
AI.method: 提出收缩路径（shrinkage path）启发式算法，将DRO问题转化为连接样本均值近似（SAA）解与经典鲁棒优化解之间线段上的一维搜索。在特定设定下推导先验次优性界，在一般情形下通过对偶公式应用类似启发式获得后验界。
AI.result: 在多商品报童问题和预约调度问题的数值实验中，收缩路径启发式能以极小的计算成本获得Wasserstein DRO相对于SAA样本外性能改进的85%-110%（报童）和45%-70%（预约调度）。
AI.conclusion: 收缩路径启发式为求解Wasserstein DRO提供了一种计算高效且实用的近似途径，能够在保持大部分性能收益的同时大幅降低求解难度，并在不同问题类型中表现出可靠的性能水平。

title: Demonstration of Space Robot Teleoperation over a Lossy and Delayed Network using ATMOS
comment: (c) 2026 the authors. This work has been accepted to IFAC for publication under a Creative Commons License CC-BY-NC-ND. 6 pages, 8 figures. Inkyu Jang and Gregorio Marchesini contributed equally to this work
summary: We present a demonstration showcasing the Autonomy Testbed for Multi-purpose Orbiting Systems (ATMOS), a planar spacecraft-analog robot designed for hardware-in-the-loop evaluation of guidance and control strategies in microgravity-like conditions. Using ATMOS as the physical test platform, we investigate the design, analysis, and performance evaluation of control architectures for remotely operated spacecraft under round-trip communication delays. In this work, we develop and experimentally validate a control strategy that combines state prediction and trajectory tracking control to perform a docking maneuver, accounting for time-varying random communication latency between ground operators and the ATMOS system. The demonstration includes a long-distance remote control experiment between Seoul and Stockholm, introducing realistic intercontinental delays and variability. The results highlight the capability of ATMOS to support rapid, reliable, and cost-effective testing of spacecraft teleoperation concepts, establishing a first step toward robust validation of on-orbit operations in microgravity-like environments.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种平面航天器模拟机器人ATMOS（多功能轨道系统自主测试平台），用于在微重力类似环境中进行硬件在环的制导与控制策略评估，并通过首尔至斯德哥尔摩的洲际远程控制实验验证了结合状态预测与轨迹跟踪的对接控制策略在随机通信延迟下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在轨服务与空间交会对接任务中，地面操作员与航天器之间存在显著的往返通信延迟（尤其在洲际距离下），这给遥操作控制带来了挑战。需要一个成本低廉、可靠且快速的物理测试平台来验证微重力类似环境下配备通信延迟的遥操作控制架构。
AI.method: 利用ATMOS平面气浮式航天器模拟机器人作为硬件测试平台，设计并实验验证了一种将状态预测与轨迹跟踪控制相结合的控制策略，用于在时变随机通信延迟条件下完成对接机动。实验设计包括首尔与斯德哥尔摩之间的长距离远程控制实验，以引入真实的洲际延迟和可变性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的控制策略能够在随机时变通信延迟下成功完成对接操作，同时证明了ATMOS平台能够支持快速、可靠且成本效益高的航天器遥操作概念验证。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为在微重力类似环境中鲁棒验证在轨操作控制方案奠定了第一步基础，展示了ATMOS作为地面测试平台在航天器遥操作验证中的实用价值与潜力。

title: AI-Assisted Discovery and Construction of a Counterexample to the Convergence of Three-Block ADMM with the Identity Matrix as its Third Constraint Block
summary: The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), as a landmark algorithm, has attracted tremendous research attention and extensive practical applications over the past two decades. It is well known that, although the two-block ADMM enjoys well-established theoretical convergence guarantees, its direct extension to the three-block case may fail to converge, as demonstrated by existing counterexamples [5]. However, to the best of our knowledge, the case in which the third constraint block is the identity remains unresolved: the existing literature gives neither a general convergence proof nor a counterexample for this subclass. In this paper, we give a negative answer: direct three-block ADMM may fail even when the first two blocks are strongly convex quadratics. Using Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol, we construct an explicit rational counterexample candidate and verify it along a piecewise-affine reduction path; exact checks show that direct three-block ADMM on this instance produces a bounded nonconvergent orbit of period 66. Within the same Codex workflow, we further guide a study of multiplier relaxation and clarify when convergence can be restored at the fixed-instance and class levels: a problem-dependent small dual step can restore convergence, whereas no positive relative step works uniformly over the whole class. Furthermore, we also test the recent Kimi Code with Kimi K3 model without the Codex candidate or project-specific route guidance; along a different path it produces an exact locally attracting period-23 certificate, convertible to an equivalent all-identity instance. The comparison suggests that different research-harness configurations can shape the mathematical objects explored and the certificates pursued.

AI.tldr: 本文证明直接三块ADMM即使在前两块为强凸二次函数时也可能不收敛，构造了周期为66的有界非收敛轨道的显式有理反例，并研究了乘子松弛恢复收敛的条件。
AI.motivation: 三块ADMM的直接推广可能不收敛已有反例，但当第三块为恒等约束时该问题悬而未决——文献中既无一般收敛性证明也无反例。
AI.method: 利用Codex与GPT-5.6 Sol构建显式有理反例，沿分段仿射降维路径进行验证；通过乘子松弛分析恢复收敛的条件（问题依赖的小步长可行、均匀正步长不可行）；另用Kimi Code与Kimi K3模型独立获得周期23的局部吸引子证书。
AI.result: 给出三块ADMM在第三块为恒等约束时不收敛的显式反例（周期66的有界非收敛轨道），并证明：针对具体实例存在小步长乘子松弛可恢复收敛，但不存在对全类统一有效的正相对步长。
AI.conclusion: 直接三块ADMM在第三约束块为恒等时依然可能失败，即使前两块为强凸二次；不同研究工具链会影响所发现的数学对象与证书类型。

title: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern (CVPR) Findings
summary: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data dependency. To demonstrate the advantages (high generalizability and low data dependency) of this framework, we first built a dataset of 30K tool-use trajectories and action demonstrations, which is much smaller than those used by baseline methods. We then designed a training regimen for long-trajectory tool-use reasoning in challenging environments. Experiments show that ART achieves a 20% higher success rate than mainstream baselines on simulation and real-world tasks, such as pick-and-place in the dark at novel viewpoints. Empirical results highlight the benefits of an agent-based approach: modular tool utilization enables more efficient training, lightweight deployment, and scalable integration of new tools. This design fosters robustness, adaptability, and extensibility, paving the way for the practical deployment of VLA systems in complex real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ART（Agentic Robot with Tool-use）框架，将端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与智能体工具使用相结合，通过工具注入机制降低动作解空间的复杂度，从而在显著减少数据依赖的同时提升跨任务泛化能力。实验表明ART在模拟和真实世界任务中比主流基线方法成功率高出20%。
AI.motivation: 传统的端到端VLA模型面临两大挑战：一是动作解空间过于庞大复杂，导致泛化能力受限；二是对大规模训练数据的强依赖，数据获取成本高昂。作者希望通过引入工具使用机制来降低动作空间的复杂性，从而同时解决泛化性和数据依赖两个核心问题。
AI.method: ART是一种工具注入框架，可对任意VLA模型进行微调，使其能够利用现成的工具模块，涵盖三个层面：底层视觉感知工具、高层可供性（affordance）推理工具和具身能力增强工具。作者构建了仅30K条工具使用轨迹和动作演示的小规模数据集，并设计了适用于挑战性环境中长轨迹工具使用推理的训练方案。
AI.result: 在模拟环境和真实世界任务（如黑暗中从新视角进行抓取放置）中，ART相比主流基线方法实现了20%更高的成功率。实验还表明，模块化工具利用带来了更高效的训练、轻量化的部署以及新工具的可扩展集成。
AI.conclusion: 基于智能体的工具使用方法为VLA系统带来了鲁棒性、适应性和可扩展性方面的显著优势，为VLA系统在复杂现实场景中的实际部署铺平了道路。

title: Residual-Controlled Douglas--Rachford Splitting for Differentiable Solver Layers
summary: Differentiable solver layers embed constrained optimization into end-to-end learning systems, but fixed-depth unrolling must trade off solution quality, feasibility, and computational budget. We propose Residual-Controlled Douglas--Rachford Splitting (RCDRS), a differentiable solver layer for conic linear programs. RCDRS treats an unrolled solver as a feedback-controlled dynamical system, where a causal controller adapts the relaxation and objective-drive parameters while preserving the projection-splitting structure of Douglas--Rachford splitting. Theoretically, we show that each fixed admissible block remains an averaged relaxed DRS operator and admits finite-step fixed-point residual bounds. We further analyze safeguarded time-varying rollouts as summable perturbations of a limiting averaged operator, and recover terminal primal-dual diagnostics from the final splitting state. Experiments on mixed-cone benchmarks and engineering applications show that RCDRS improves solution quality, feasibility and downstream decision performance. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RC-DRS-180C/.

AI.tldr: 提出残差控制Douglas-Rachford分裂（RCDRS），一种用于锥线性规划的可微求解器层。它将展开求解器视为反馈控制动态系统，通过因果控制器自适应调节松弛与目标驱动参数，在保持投影分裂结构的同时，理论证明固定块仍为平均松弛DRS算子且具有有限步定点残差界，实验表明其优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 固定的展开深度必须在解质量、可行性和计算预算之间进行权衡，缺乏自适应的求解策略。现有可微求解器层难以同时兼顾收敛精度与端到端学习效率，需要一种能够自适应调整求解路径的方法。
AI.method: 将展开的求解器建模为反馈控制的动力系统：因果控制器根据当前残差状态动态调整松弛参数和目标驱动参数，同时保持Douglas-Rachford分裂的投影拆分结构。理论分析包括：固定可容许块的DRS算子性质、时变rollout作为极限平均算子的可加扰动分析、从最终分裂状态恢复原始-对偶终止诊断。
AI.result: 在混合锥基准测试和工程应用上，RCDRS在解质量、可行性以及下游决策性能方面均优于基线方法，同时保持了可微求解器层的端到端训练能力。
AI.conclusion: RCDRS通过将可微求解器重新解释为受控动力系统，有效解决了固定深度展开的精度-可行性-预算折中问题，为可微优化层提供了理论保障与实用性能的统一框架。

title: FlatLab: A Unified Methodology Framework and Simulation-Based Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation of Flat Objects
comment: This paper is accepted to ICML 2026
summary: Robotic manipulation of flat objects is challenging due to the ungraspable configurations and strong variations in object geometry and material. Existing methods rely on heuristic pre-manipulation and are often evaluated in closed settings with limited generalization. We propose a unified framework that decouples the manipulation into a strategy generator and an action execution module. The strategy generator predicts appropriate manipulation strategies from object point clouds by learning strategy-centric, object-invariant representations via simulated data transformation and contrastive learning. Conditioned on the predicted strategy, the execution module decomposes long-horizon manipulation into reusable action primitives and dynamically composes them to generate stable trajectories. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce FlatLab, a comprehensive simulation benchmark for robotic flat object manipulation. FlatLab provides high-fidelity physical simulation of diverse rigid and deformable flat objects, automated multi-modal data collection, and standardized task definitions and evaluation protocols. Experiments conducted in FlatLab demonstrate that our approach generalizes effectively to unseen objects and categories, outperforming existing baselines. The project page and the code are provided at https://flatlab-web.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将操作解耦为策略生成器和动作执行模块的统一的平面物体机器人操作框架，并引入FlatLab仿真基准来系统评估方法在未见物体和类别上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 平面物体的机器人操作因不可抓取构型以及物体几何和材质差异大而具有挑战性。现有方法依赖启发式预操作，且在封闭环境中评估、泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 将操作解耦为两个模块：1) 策略生成器，通过模拟数据变换和对比学习学习策略中心、物体不变的表示，从物体点云预测合适的操作策略；2) 动作执行模块，根据预测策略将长时程操作分解为可复用的动作基元，并动态组合生成稳定轨迹。同时提出FlatLab仿真基准，提供高保真物理仿真、自动化多模态数据采集、标准化任务定义和评估协议。
AI.result: 在FlatLab中的实验表明，所提方法能有效泛化到未见物体和类别，性能优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在FlatLab上的系统评估验证了所提出解耦框架在平面物体操作中具有良好的泛化能力，为这一挑战性任务提供了新的统一解决方案和标准化评估基准。

title: On quantitative sufficient second-order optimality conditions for elliptic optimal control problems
summary: In this paper, a quantitative condition for optimality for distributed optimal control problems with box-constraints that are subject to a semilinear elliptic equation is considered. An important property of the investigated optimal control problems is the absence of a Tikhonov regularization. It is well known that at a given control, the second variation is a quadratic form in the linearized state, and its curvature coefficient function may vanish or change sign. We present a quantitative condition that implies coercivity with respect to the $L^2$-norm of the linearized-states. As a consequence, the stability of the second-order condition under perturbations of the states and the tracking data is shown.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无Tikhonov正则化的半线性椭圆方程盒约束分布式最优控制问题，提出了一种保证线性化状态L²范数下强制性的定量二阶最优性条件，并证明了该条件在状态和跟踪数据扰动下的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 无Tikhonov正则化的最优控制问题中，二阶变分是线性化状态的二次型，其曲率系数函数可能消失或变号，导致经典二阶充分条件失效。需要一个定量的条件来保证强制性和二阶条件的稳定性。
AI.method: 研究了无Tikhonov正则化的半线性椭圆方程盒约束分布式最优控制问题，提出了一个定量条件来确保关于线性化状态L²范数的强制性（coercivity），进而推导二阶条件的稳定性结论。
AI.result: 给出了一个定量条件，该条件蕴含关于线性化状态L²范数的强制性，并由此证明了二阶条件在状态扰动和跟踪数据扰动下的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 在一个曲率系数可能消失或变号的非标准设定下，通过引入定量条件恢复了二阶最优性条件的有效性及其在数据扰动下的稳定性。

title: PILOT: Privileged Imitation Learning for End-to-End Motion Planning of Autonomous UAVs under Partial Observability
summary: Autonomous navigation in cluttered environments is hampered by partial observability and dynamic constraints. This paper presents PILOT, a constraint-aware privileged imitation learning framework for vision-based end-to-end UAV motion planning under partial observability. The framework distills planning strategies from a computationally intensive optimal control expert into a student policy regularized toward safety and dynamic requirements via a dual-objective loss function. To mitigate partial observability, a spatiotemporal perception fusion module using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is developed to integrate historical depth images and odometry. This module infers task-relevant latent context from historical observations, enhancing spatial awareness beyond the instantaneous FOV without maintaining persistent map memory. A trajectory parameterization layer mapping network outputs to a structured trajectory, while enabling explicit continuity, dynamic-consistency, and obstacle soft penalties during training, encouraging constraint satisfaction for unseen observations without formal guarantees. Simulations on quadrotor and fixed-wing aircraft demonstrate that PILOT achieves performance comparable to the privileged expert while reducing computational overhead by over 80\%. Successful indoor and outdoor zero-shot deployment confirms the practical feasibility and cross-domain generalization of the planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PILOT框架，一种基于约束感知的特权模仿学习框架，用于视觉端到端UAV运动规划。它通过双目标损失函数将最优控制专家的规划策略蒸馏到学生策略中，并结合TCN时空感知融合模块缓解部分可观测性问题。实验表明，PILOT在四旋翼和固定翼仿真中达到与特权专家相当的性能，计算开销降低80%以上，并成功实现了室内外零样本部署。
AI.motivation: 杂乱环境中的自主导航受到部分可观测性和动态约束的阻碍。给定历史深度图像和里程计信息，视觉端到端UAV运动规划需要在资源受限平台上实现实时、安全且动态可行的轨迹生成，同时克服瞬时视野（FOV）的限制和计算开销过大的问题。
AI.method: PILOT框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 双目标损失函数，将计算密集型最优控制专家的规划策略蒸馏到学生策略中，同时正则化安全和动态要求；(2) 基于时序卷积网络（TCN）的时空感知融合模块，整合历史深度图像和里程计以推断任务相关的潜在上下文，增强超出瞬时FOV的空间感知能力；(3) 轨迹参数化层，将网络输出映射为结构化轨迹，在训练中显式施加连续性、动态一致性和障碍物软惩罚约束。
AI.result: 在四旋翼和固定翼飞机的仿真中，PILOT实现了与特权专家相当的性能，同时将计算开销降低了80%以上。室内和室外零样本部署的成功验证了该规划器的实际可行性和跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PILOT通过特权模仿学习与约束感知正则化的结合，有效解决了部分可观测下视觉UAV运动规划的挑战，在不维持持久地图记忆的前提下实现了与最优专家媲美的规划质量，并通过零样本部署展示了良好的跨域泛化能力。尽管无法为未见观测提供正式的安全保证，该框架在计算效率和部署可行性方面具有显著优势。

title: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. For training, we use competitive self-play with Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) and a diversified opponent pool, enabling agents to improve against historical policies while stabilizing optimization and reducing policy oscillation. This process leads to the emergence of sophisticated pursuit and evasion strategies. For real-world deployment, we develop a hardware-aligned simulation pipeline that models actuator-response dynamics, communication latency, and domain randomization. The learned policies transfer zero-shot to real quadrotors without task-specific tuning. Real-world experiments reproduce pursuit-evasion tactics observed in simulation, including rapid dodging and flanking, and demonstrate interactive two-agent zero-shot deployment.

AI.tldr: AgilePE是一个基于自博弈强化学习的完整无人机追捕-逃逸系统，实现了从敏捷底层控制到竞争策略优化再到仿真到现实部署的统一框架。策略直接将机载状态观测映射为集体推力和机体角速度指令，通过优先级虚构自我对弈（PFSP）和多样化对手池进行训练，最终实现零样本迁移到真实四旋翼无人机上。
AI.motivation: 自主追捕-逃逸是无人机面临的基础挑战，需要在强耦合动力学和不断变化的对手行为下快速决策。传统基于规则或微分博弈的方法难以应对高维空中交互和敏捷机动，因此需要一种端到端的学习方法。
AI.method: 采用自博弈强化学习框架：1）策略直接映射机载状态观测到集体推力和机体角速率（CTBR）命令，实现无中间轨迹规划器的端到端敏捷机动；2）使用优先级虚构自我对弈（PFSP）和多样化对手池进行竞争性策略优化，以稳定训练并减少策略振荡；3）构建硬件对齐的仿真管线，建模执行器响应动力学、通信延迟和领域随机化，实现零样本转移到真实四旋翼。
AI.result: 学到的策略无需任务特定微调即可零样本迁移到真实四旋翼上。真实世界实验复现了仿真中观察到的追捕-逃逸策略，包括快速闪避和侧翼包抄等战术，并展示了交互式双智能体零样本部署。
AI.conclusion: AgilePE证明了自博弈强化学习配合硬件对齐的仿真管线能够使无人机在追捕-逃逸任务中涌现出复杂的敏捷战术，且策略具备良好的仿真到现实迁移能力。

title: Vibration Suppression in Collaborative Flexible Payload Manipulation Using Passive Force Control
comment: Published in the proceedings of the 2026 European Control Conference (ECC)
summary: In large and heavy structures, vibrations arise during motion, posing significant challenges for precise manipulation. To accomplish the desired motion, control algorithms must effectively suppress these structural vibrations. In cutting edge projects, such as remote maintenance of future fusion energy reactors (tokamaks), the manipulation of this type of structure is defined as a crucial task. This paper presents a control strategy to suppress transverse vibrations in flexible payloads during motion using a collaborative payload manipulation approach. Two different industrial robot arms are arranged in a leader follower configuration for the manipulation strategy. The leader robot guides the motion with shaped velocity commands, while the follower robot ensures compliance with the estimated external forces applied by the leader on the payload through an admittance controller. Unlike existing methods, the proposed approach enables collaborative manipulation of heavier and larger flexible objects, addressing additional challenges such as vibration suppression and heterogeneous robot specifications. The dynamics of the leader follower payload system are modeled using an equivalent mass spring damper model, and it is shown that, with appropriate admittance parameters, the total energy of the system is passively dissipated. A stability proof is also provided. Numerical simulations validate the proposed method, and experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于主从（leader-follower）配置的双工业机械臂协作载荷操控策略，用于抑制大型柔性载荷在运动过程中的横向振动。领导者机器人产生整形速度指令引导运动，跟随者机器人通过导纳控制器对外部力保持柔顺，从而实现重型和大型柔性物体的协作操控。
AI.motivation: 在大型重型结构中，运动过程中产生的振动对精确操控构成重大挑战。特别是在未来聚变反应堆（托卡马克）远程维护等前沿项目中，柔性载荷的可靠操控被视为关键任务。现有方法难以实现对更重、更大的柔性物体进行协作操控，且面临振动抑制和异构机器人规格差异等额外挑战。
AI.method: 采用主从（leader-follower）配置的双工业机械臂协作操控方案。领导者机器人通过整形速度命令引导运动，跟随者机器人通过导纳控制器根据领导者施加的外部力估计值实现柔顺响应。系统动力学采用等效质量-弹簧-阻尼模型进行建模，并证明在适当的导纳参数下系统总能量被动耗散，同时提供了稳定性证明。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了所提出的方法，实验结果证明了其有效性。该方法能够抑制柔性载荷运动过程中的横向振动，并实现异构机器人协作操控更重、更大的柔性物体。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的主从协作载荷操控策略能够有效抑制柔性载荷的横向振动，通过被动耗散系统能量保证稳定性，为大型柔性结构（如托卡马克远程维护）的精确操控提供了可行的解决方案。

title: OccPlanner: Goal-Aware Occupancy-Conditioned Diffusion Planner for Pixel-Goal Navigation
comment: Technical report. 11 pages, 6 figures, and 2 tables
summary: Pixel-goal navigation specifies targets directly in the agent's camera view, but a target pixel provides neither metric depth nor traversability, making 3D goal grounding and collision-free continuous planning challenging. We present OccPlanner, a goal-aware occupancy-conditioned diffusion planner that grounds pixel goals in egocentric metric space and sequentially conditions the goal representation on temporal visual context and learned local 3D occupancy features. To provide occupancy supervision at scale, we introduce L3ROcc, which converts monocular RGB navigation videos into robot-centric local 3D occupancy annotations through geometric reconstruction and ray-based visibility reasoning. We train OccPlanner on InternData-N1 and evaluate it in closed-loop simulation across four unseen scene categories from InternScenes and two goal-distance ranges.
